added_comments.text: // Precedence (lowest to highest): defaults < config file < environment.

rationale: The agent removed the _PROD_OVERRIDES workaround entirely and fixed the underlying defect: mergeLayers was called with env before file, so the file layer clobbered every env override; swapping the order makes all nested and top-level env vars win. The SEC-207 deletion of envLayer.logLevel in production is untouched and a regression test for it was added.
